_comment: EIA Europe Brent spot in GBP. Official RBRTED.htm release dated 28 October 2026, fetched 28 October after publication, reports $123.10/bbl for 27 October (28 October cell remains blank). The same-day BoE XUDLUSS 16:00 fix already ingested is 1.3313 USD/GBP: Math.round((123.10 / 1.3313) * 100) / 100 = 92.47 GBP/bbl. The EIA v2 API was still on 20 October when its public HTML had advanced to 27 October; the adapter now checks that official table when the API lags. No price from the in-progress/unpublished 28 October period is used.
